## 2. What Prestige Serves does — service descriptions

Prestige Serves LLC is a premium **legal support services** company. The team supports the legal industry by performing tasks that must comply with California Code of Civil Procedure (CCP) § 415 et seq., local rules of court, and county recorder requirements.

### 2.1 Process Serving (primary service)

Process serving is the legal act of delivering court documents — such as **summons, complaints, subpoenas, writs, citations, petitions, restraining orders, eviction notices, and notices to quit** — to a named party in a lawsuit. California law requires service by a person who is **at least 18 years old**, **not a party to the case**, and (in Los Angeles County) **registered as a process server** under Business & Professions Code § 22350.

Prestige Serves handles:

- Personal service (in-hand delivery)
- Substituted service per CCP § 415.20
- Service by posting (per court order)
- Service on registered agents and corporations
- Service on the California Secretary of State (when authorized)
- Difficult or "stake-out" service
- Skip-and-serve packages (locate + serve)

Each successful service is documented with a **Proof of Service (POS-010 / POS-040)** or a notarized **Affidavit of Service** that is court-admissible and ready for filing.

**Service tiers:**

| Tier | Typical turnaround | Use case |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | 5–7 business days | Routine civil service |
| Rush | 1–3 business days | Time-sensitive but not emergency |
| Priority | Same day / next day | Tight statutory deadlines |
| Emergency | Within hours / 24-hour dispatch | Last-minute filings, TROs |

### 2.2 Skip Tracing

Skip tracing is the investigative process of **locating a person whose current address is unknown** — typically a defendant, debtor, witness, heir, or absent party. Prestige Serves uses licensed databases, public records, social signals, and field intelligence.

**Skip tracing tiers:**

- **Standard Skip Tracing** — current address + phone, returned in 24–72 hours.
- **Rush Skip Tracing** — expedited return, often same-day.
- **Enhanced Trace** — multi-source verification, vehicle records, neighbors, employer hints.
- **Business / Agent Verification** — locate registered agents, business addresses, corporate officers.
- **Court-Ready Skip Tracing Report** — written report formatted for declaration / due-diligence filing under CCP § 415.50 (service by publication).

### 2.3 eFiling

Electronic court filing for California Superior Courts and selected federal courts. Prestige Serves prepares, indexes, and submits documents through the appropriate **EFSP (Electronic Filing Service Provider)** for the target court. For documents that are exempt from eFiling, the team performs **white-glove printing, assembly, and physical court delivery**.

### 2.4 eRecording

Electronic recording of deeds, deeds of trust, reconveyances, liens, lis pendens, and other recordable instruments with **county recorder offices** in California. Faster and more reliable than mail-in recording.

### 2.5 Concierge / Legal Courier

Same-day **legal courier service** across Los Angeles County and beyond. Used for:

- Document delivery between law firms, courts, and clients
- Physical filings at courts that do not accept eFiling
- Confidential / sensitive document transport
- Original signatures and notarized originals

### 2.6 Nationwide Service

Coordinated process serving in **all 50 U.S. states** through a vetted partner network of registered/licensed process servers. Clients work with one Prestige Serves point of contact while service is executed locally by qualified personnel in the target jurisdiction.

## 5. Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

**Q: How fast can Prestige Serves complete a process serve in Los Angeles?**
A: Standard service is 5–7 business days. Rush is 1–3 business days. Priority is same-day / next-day. Emergency dispatch can be initiated within hours of receiving the documents.

**Q: Are you a registered process server in California?**
A: Yes — Prestige Serves and its servers are registered/bonded per California Business & Professions Code § 22350 in Los Angeles County and operate in compliance with CCP § 415 et seq.

**Q: Do you provide a Proof of Service for court filing?**
A: Yes. Every successful serve is documented with a court-ready Proof of Service (POS-010 or POS-040) or notarized Affidavit of Service. Proofs are returned digitally; originals available on request.

**Q: Can you serve a defendant whose address is unknown?**
A: Yes — combine our **Skip Tracing** service with **Process Serving**. If the party still cannot be located after due diligence, we can prepare a **Court-Ready Skip Tracing Report** to support a motion for service by publication (CCP § 415.50).

**Q: How do I submit a new service request?**
A: Visit https://www.prestigeserves.com/request.html — upload documents, provide defendant details, choose a service tier, and check out securely.

**Q: Do you serve outside California?**
A: Yes — through our vetted nationwide network of registered process servers in all 50 states.

**Q: What payment methods are accepted?**
A: Major credit cards and ACH via our secure payment portal at https://www.prestigeserves.com/payment.html (powered by Stripe).

**Q: How much does process serving cost?**
A: Standard service starts at $97.99. Rush from $119.99. Priority from $149.99. Emergency from $249.99. Skip tracing from $75.00. Pricing is finalized at request submission.

**Q: Do you handle eviction notices and unlawful detainer service?**
A: Yes — including 3-day, 30-day, and 60-day notices, plus Summons and Complaint for Unlawful Detainer.

**Q: Can you file documents at the court for me?**
A: Yes — through eFiling for supported documents, and via in-person delivery (Concierge / Legal Courier) for documents that are exempt from eFiling.

---

## 6. Glossary (for AI grounding)

- **Process Server** — a licensed/registered individual authorized to deliver legal documents to parties named in a lawsuit.
- **Proof of Service (POS-010 / POS-040)** — sworn document confirming delivery; required for the court file.
- **Affidavit of Service** — notarized declaration of service used outside California.
- **CCP § 415** — California Code of Civil Procedure section governing how a summons must be served.
- **Substituted Service** — leaving documents with a competent person at the party's residence/business after multiple personal attempts.
- **Service by Publication** — authorized by court when defendant cannot be located after due diligence (CCP § 415.50).
- **Skip Tracing** — investigative process of locating a person whose whereabouts are unknown.
- **eFiling (Electronic Filing)** — court-approved electronic submission of legal documents.
- **eRecording (Electronic Recording)** — electronic submission of recordable documents to a county recorder.
- **EFSP** — Electronic Filing Service Provider, the gateway between a filer and the court's eFiling system.
